text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thank you for the food. I should 
head to sleep soon to prepare for 
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm... A blackout?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, it's okay! Stay calm! Please 
don't move from where you are!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah! Someone help meee...! *hic*... 
I'm so scared~...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That voice is... Mayano! You're in the 
kitchen, right? I'll come pick you up 
right away!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Close your eyes and focus... Picture the 
scenery you always see...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! That's the image!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Three tables along the wall... and from my 
current position to the counter is about 
ten steps... got it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oops... is this a table leg? I need to 
watch my step...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! This open space is the 
counter! Now if I just follow the wall to 
the left...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: *sniffle*... *sniffle*... Fuji... senpai?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Mayano! It's 
all good now!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...The light is back. It's not scary 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa! Fuji-senpai~~♪ Thanks for 
comiiing!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I can't just leave a crying princess 
all alone, now can I?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Ehh~~! Maya's a princess!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. You're a hard worker, and 
such a lovely princess♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpai looks like a real prince...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, now, running is dangerous, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that concentration from earlier— 
I might be able to put it to use in 
races...!

The next day, Fuji Kiseki showed up to 
training looking sharper than ever!
